notes.name: Pan de muerto
notes.body: orange zest, anise, butter, six eggs for ten loaves, rest two hours, sugar while warm

notes.name: Pan de yema
notes.body: egg yolk dough, sesame on top, the Oaxaca way with chocolate on the side

notes.name: Conchas
notes.body: vanilla and chocolate topping, rest overnight, score before the oven

notes.name: Empanadas de amarillo
notes.body: mole amarillo, chicken, hoja santa, fold and crimp, bake until golden

notes.name: Polvorones for the posadas
notes.body: butter, flour, powdered sugar, pecans, bake twelve minutes

notes.name: Mama Carmen's tamales
notes.body: masa with lard, mole negro, banana leaf, steam two hours

notes.name: Supplier prices
notes.body: flour 25 kilo bag 520 pesos, eggs 58 a dozen, butter 118 a kilo, sugar 24 a kilo

notes.name: Oven problems
notes.body: thermostat drifts twenty degrees, left deck runs hot, technician is Don Chato from the Abastos

notes.name: Staff schedule
notes.body: Beto starts at three, Yesenia opens the counter at six, Emi does the deliveries

notes.name: Menu prices 2026
notes.body: concha 12, pan de yema 15, pan de muerto 38, empanada 35, cake slice 45

notes.name: Dia de Muertos plan
notes.body: three hundred loaves, boxes from the print shop, stall opens at six on the thirty-first

notes.name: Christmas program songs
notes.body: Noche de Paz, Ven a Cantar, Campanas sobre Campanas, a Oaxacan villancico for the finale

notes.name: Alto part notes
notes.body: Maestro says breathe before the high passage, hold the last note for four counts

notes.name: Mass rota
notes.body: first Sunday Santo Domingo, third Sunday San Felipe, choir arrives forty minutes before

notes.name: Choir dues record
notes.body: fifty pesos a month, Cuauhtemoc is two months behind, Lupita paid until December

notes.name: Diary entry - the long night
notes.body: baked 200 loaves for the market order, the oven went cold twice, Emi saved the batch

notes.name: Diary entry - Dani's call
notes.body: she picked the dress, cried a little, Rodrigo's mother will bring the mezcal

notes.name: Wedding ideas
notes.body: marigold centerpieces, the choir sings at the church, tamales for the late supper

notes.name: Mama Carmen's medicines
notes.body: metformin morning and night, losartan once, vitamin D on Sundays, doctor wants the sugar test

notes.name: Van log
notes.body: kilometres 118000 at the last service, brake pads checked, oil every 5000 km, tires in August

notes.name: House repairs
notes.body: roof leak fixed over the kitchen, water tank needs cleaning, the gate hinge squeaks

notes.name: Gift ideas for Mama Carmen
notes.body: a rebozo, new glasses, a rocking chair for the patio

notes.name: Monthly budget
notes.body: flour 14000, wages 16000, electricity 4200, gas 3000, van 2500, save what is left

notes.name: Old shopping list

notes.body: Panaderia La Espiga, bread from the oven since 1998
